messages.subject: item discrimination
parts:
Hello,
I want to write codes for item discrimination which has positive values in SAS. To obtain positive item discrimination should we use lognormal distrubuiton or another thing? Do you have any suggestion?
Thanks,
Sakine.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: item discrimination
parts:
Log-normal distribution is fine since all values will be positive in
this distributions. This distribution is also used for discrimination
priors in some software, like BILOG-MG.

Phil
